essential: You guide a knight through a 2D side-scrolling platformer level. Reach the exit of the level alive. Levels like this lead to the right. Spikes kill at once. Enemies hurt on touch; three sword strikes kill one. You choose a behaviour; reflexes carry it out and stop when something changes.

Situation: Health 5 of 5. You stand on a stone floor. To the right the floor continues as far as you can see. To the left a wall blocks the way after 2 steps. A wall on the left can be climbed with wall jumps; what is above is not known. No enemy in sight.

action.instructions: Choose the behaviour that makes progress toward the exit while keeping the knight alive.

criteria.advance_right: Go right toward the exit: walk, jump to the next platform. Now: the way is open.
criteria.retreat_left: Step back left, up to 3 steps, away from the exit.
criteria.wait: Stand still for one second and watch.
